title_zh: 区分心脏模型动画与实际测量

scenario.label_zh: 准备心脏模型演示并区分模拟与实际测量
scenario.goal_zh: 核对模型按钮和动画用途并约定在演示中说明不测量人体

context_zh: 科学课堂中，教师 Talia 与学生 Max 准备一个使用红色水和屏幕动画的心脏模型展示。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: Does this button pump the red water through the model?

sentences.speaker: Talia
sentences.text: Yes. Pressing it starts the demonstration.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: And the pulse on the screen belongs to the person pressing the button?

sentences.speaker: Talia
sentences.text: No, it's a programmed animation. There isn't a sensor attached to anyone.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: Then I'll explain that before inviting someone to press the button.

sentences.speaker: Talia
sentences.text: Please do. We want visitors to see the model, not think they're receiving a health reading.
